step.evidence: https://bcc.curriqunet.com/catalog/view//iq/40736/41800/41802 (the catalog's 'California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC)' tab under Transfer Information, list 41800; read with its _getPage, https://bcc.curriqunet.com/Catalog/_getPage?catalogId=10327&id=41802, by college page read run 43140339800, plan kb/college_reads/berkeley_city_ge_guides.json, S639): the tab prints the pattern's areas with no units and no total, as this entry's why records ('the catalog's Cal-GETC tab (node 41802, the same read) prints the pattern's areas with no units and no total, so no figure rests on Berkeley City's own words'). The transfer degrees name Cal-GETC beside 'Total Units 60' and print one combined 'General Education (Cal-GETC) and Elective Courses N' line (English AA-T 31138: 'Major Requirements 22', 'General Education (Cal-GETC) and Elective Courses 38', 'Total Units 60', by its reading's own note), which no GE figure rests on either. So the catalog names Cal-GETC and prints no figure for it, the shape Sam's Sheet 187 card 5 ('Use 34 statewide', 2026-11-13) fills under d-calgetc-34-per-college-evidence-s648. S689, the cheap-piles worker: the 21 transfer degrees S639 left waiting take the statewide 34 through the rule's record, section and sum gates; the reconcile run's fresh text runs the section gates.
step.combined_line: General Education (Cal-GETC) and Elective Courses 38 (English AA-T 31138, between 'Major Requirements 22' and 'Total Units 60'): one figure for general education and electives together, the degree's remainder after the major, read as no Cal-GETC figure only where major plus it is the degree total and it is at least 34 (calgetc_combined)
